name: Mr. Sprinkle
description: Custom grillz, jewelry, and WETT accessories by Mr. Sprinkle. The only in-person appointment venue is Envy Kutz — Braids & Locs in downtown Reno, Nevada; service inquiries from nearby Northern Nevada communities are considered individually.
appointmentPolicy: Appointment only, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM. In-person appointments are at Envy Kutz — Braids & Locs, 275 E 4th St, Reno, NV 89501. Requests are not confirmed until the team contacts the customer. Mobile mold service is separate and subject to location, schedule, and team confirmation.
services: Mobile mold service (separate offering; not a physical location)

standardShipping.toCustomerEstimate: Approximately 2-3 days after production and dispatch
standardShipping.customerFacingExpectation: Plan for around two weeks or longer overall; planning guidance only, not a guaranteed completion date.
standardShipping.qualifications: Carrier transit, production capacity, design complexity, and final shipping coverage must be confirmed before the order is accepted.

rushShipping.carrier: Next-day shipping to and from the main office
rushShipping.productionPriority: Rush orders receive top priority in the production queue.
rushShipping.minimumCompletionExpectation: At least 4 days, subject to eligibility, production capacity, and carrier schedules.
rushShipping.qualifications: Confirm rush eligibility and a realistic completion estimate before accepting payment.

fulfillment.simpleDesignException: Basic silver or gold grillz without stones or custom designs may be produced in approximately 2 days. This is a production estimate only and does not guarantee total delivery time.

faq.question: Where are Mr. Sprinkle's in-person appointments?
faq.answer: Appointments are required and take place only at Envy Kutz — Braids & Locs, 275 E 4th St, Reno, NV 89501, above Davidson's Distillery. Regular appointment hours are 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Mobile mold service is separate and subject to scheduling confirmation.

faq.question: How much is standard shipping for grillz?
faq.answer: The approved standard shipping charge is $60 by FedEx standard. Confirm shipping coverage and order-specific details before purchase.

faq.question: How long does standard grillz fulfillment take?
faq.answer: Production generally takes 2-7 business days. Shipping is approximately 2-3 days to the main office and approximately 2-3 days back to the customer. Customers should plan for around two weeks or longer overall; this is a qualified estimate, not a guaranteed date.

faq.question: Are diamond prices the finished price for diamond grillz?
faq.answer: The published estimator uses the selected stone type, clarity, size, and count. Stone-setting labor is included in the published pricing. Custom finishes and designs outside the catalog still require a quote.

faq.question: Are custom cuts charged per tooth?
faq.answer: Individual-tooth fabrication is $10 per pair of teeth and deep/bar cuts are $15 per pair of teeth. Diamond/Dust is $30 per upper or lower piece, Center/Split is $20 per upper or lower piece, and Open Face/Window is $40 per upper or lower piece.

faq.question: Can customers from Tahoe, the Bay Area, or Seattle book a local office?
faq.answer: No. The only in-person appointment venue is Envy Kutz — Braids & Locs in Reno, Nevada. Customers in nearby Northern Nevada communities may request availability; mobile mold and shipping arrangements must be confirmed individually. There are no Mr. Sprinkle offices in Tahoe, the Bay Area, or Seattle.
